main_body: stack of three cheese wheels (one on top of two)
top_band: pale yellow 2-row rim on the top wheel (rows 4-5) and on the lower wheels (rows 9-10)
evidence: Each cheese wheel is drawn with only a 2px light yellow top band (rows 4-5 on the upper wheel, rows 9-10 on the lower two wheels) over a flat 4px golden-yellow front face (rows 6-8 and 11-13) and a 1px dark brown base line (rows 9 and 14). The top caps do not read as foreshortened ellipses and have no front-edge separation or overhang shadow—matching the 'rim only / barrel: lid 2px' failure.

style.evidence: Only 3 tones are used across the entire sprite (pale yellow, mid yellow-gold, dark brown). The front faces of all three cheese wheels are completely flat blocks of a single yellow tone with no cylindrical shading, holes, grain, or specular detail, making it look much flatter and simpler than the Beodeul references.
